params.body:
On real data most of the top relations share no projects with the others drawn (clients with their own projects). Without a line they were pushed out by repulsion to a wide ring, so the fitted picture was mostly empty space and the linked cluster a tiny knot in the middle. Opened projects started on top of the dot they came from and piled up, names and all, especially in 3D.

- Repulsion reaches at most 260 units. Linked dots are drawn gently to the middle (0.03).
- Dots without a line sit on a ring just outside the linked ones (`forceRadial`, radius from the number of linked dots), instead of drifting out or being pulled into the cluster.
- Dots that just opened start on a circle around their parent (a Fibonacci sphere in 3D) rather than at the parent, and lines to opened dots are longer (70), so they unfold.
- In 3D opened projects carry no name until pointed at; they are many and close together, and the tooltip names them.

Checked in headless Chromium on a production-size local database with 25 added clients that share no projects: the unlinked ones form a ring at radius 278 around a cluster of radius 150 (before: a wide ring with the cluster small in the middle); opening the busiest relation spreads its 25 projects around it. JS tests 13/13.
